title: Section 480 BNSS — Bail in non-bailable offences

content.heading: When bail may be taken in case of non-bailable offence
content.text: When any person accused of, or suspected of, the commission of any non-bailable offence is arrested or detained without warrant by an officer in charge of a police station or appears or is brought before a Court other than the High Court or Court of Session, he may be released on bail subject to the restrictions enacted, including offences punishable with death or life imprisonment. This is the successor of CrPC 437.
